server.note: ready_ms is the figure that Vite printed. The Playwright library drove the checks from the repository root (phase-3-probe.mjs in the evidence directory), because the rows need separate contexts, WebKit and phone emulation. Each variant used fresh contexts. All values per variant are in phase-3-probe-results.json. Three driver errors were fixed between runs, with no source change: one extra AC-3.14 row compared lastFileSaveAt, which the save sets after the driver read the album; one extra AC-3.22 regex expected the archive text for a ZIP whose album.json is not JSON; and the relink sweep expected a file chooser without its dialog and then chose 2 of 3 photos. The server was started a second time, on the port that doctor.mjs port resolved again, to add one AC-3.14 row that proves the changed gutter. doctor.mjs stop reported free_after true both times.
